remarks: Builder's Special! Incredible opportunity to complete a luxury custom home in the sought-after North Stamford area. Framing is already underway, and the project is off to a strong start. The existing foundation from the original structure is in place. This level lot comes with approved plans for a stunning 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home offering 5,438 sq ft above grade, plus 1,778 sq ft in the basement. A brand-new septic system has been installed and is approved for five bedrooms. Property is being sold as-is. Survey available upon request. Additional plans and documentation are available for review. Please ask for more details - a rare find for builders or buyers looking to create a high-end dream home in a prestigious location. Please do not enter the house, as it's unfinished and not safe to go inside.
